tilts.set: SET on 2026-10-30 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Double Underweight, carried unchanged, with the counter-case strengthened and named. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): property is valued off a yield and financed with leverage, the US 10-year is near 5.10%, the Fed hikes in December, and real estate was not spoken to as an industry. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: F now, D prior at industry level, every property sector D or F. The counter-case is stronger this week than at any time since the row was set: yields fell on firm data, Goldman Sachs upgraded bonds to overweight 'moving from headwind to hedge' (16 and 19 Oct), and real estate investment trusts were among the only sectors bought (Jefferies desk, 17 Oct); if that rally is a trend, this is the row where the tilt costs most, and it is the first row I would lift. Held at F because one week's rally with the policy rate still rising is a hedge working, not a peak, and the condition on the sector rows (back to D if the US 10-year falls under 4.5%) is 60 basis points away.

sector.why: Double Underweight, set deliberately this week (carried F from the old TBD property row). Component 1 regime, 16-Oct-26 (a discount-rate shock with the first credit crack inside the artificial intelligence chain: United States core inflation re-accelerating on energy, the Fed and Bank of England hikes pulled forward, the US 10-year about 5.1%, the US joined the sell-off and Asia is in washout, defensives bid for four weeks in Europe, European breadth off its three-year lows but in the bottom quarter, the consumer forecast to weaken into winter; sources present 2026-W42): the discount-rate line on a leveraged, yield-valued asset, plus the tenant side: every house expects the consumer to weaken this winter under an energy-led cost-of-living shock. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-16 against 2026-08-14, not week on week: D now, D prior, the least weak property sector, which is noted and is not enough to lift it while both legs point down. No MI Pool name. Counter-case: retail property has already de-rated for a decade and its yields are the highest in property; back to D on a European consumer reading that is not falling.

geography.why: Neutral, carried as a judgement with the evidence now read both ways, on the special topic 'The UK Budget of 28-Oct-26': the Budget removed a UK-specific fiscal tail risk from the discount rate without lowering it (headroom £15bn, both rules met, the 10-year gilt about 5.32% and its lowest in over a month, gilts outperforming Bunds and Treasuries by about 5 basis points), and the UK data beat on every count (growth 0.7% on three months, employment up 102,000, purchasing managers' indices beating; Pacific, 26 October); against it, 2027 growth cut to 1.0% from 1.6%, unemployment 5.1% in 2027, the energy price cap up about 16% in January, a Bank of England rise to 4.00% almost priced for 5-Nov-26, and banks made the first payer in the next shock. Neutral against Underweight was tested; the data say the consumer slows rather than breaks, so Neutral, with no weight carried in Thematic Fit/Momentum. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44). 22 of the 144 Pool stocks are UK-listed. Counter-case: a 1.0% growth year with a hiking central bank is an Underweight in most books. To D on hawkish guidance on 5-Nov-26, a January price cap above 16% or a spring fiscal event with broad taxes; to B if a second source makes the UK case with the rate path read.
